verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is an offline USB/NFC hardware security key (FIDO2, OATH, PIV, OpenPGP) that needs no software or drivers. It has no hosted service that could emit events, so subscribing to outbound HTTP webhooks is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any webhook or event-subscription capability; the probes only show no OpenAPI spec and a store-generated llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
